newsitem.title: USA: Florida sees 20.9 pct business increase in 1994.
newsitem.headline: Florida sees 20.9 pct business increase in 1994.

text.p: The number of businesses in Florida totaled 392,762 in 1994, an increase of 8,035, or 20.9 percent, over the previous year, the U.S. Commerce Department said in a business patterns study released Tuesday.
Payroll for the state rose to $110.8 billion in 1994, an increase of $6.7 billion, or 6.5 percent, over 1993, the department said.
The number of employees grew to 4.98 million in 1994, an increase of 178,382 employees, or 3.7 percent, over 1993, the department said.
The services sector employed the largest portion of the state's private-sector work force in 1994, 38.6 percent, with an average annual payroll per employee of $22,503.
Among the five counties with the most businesses, Dade County saw its number of buisnesses rise by one percent to 65,450 during the period, while payrolls rose by 2.7 percent, to $19.3 billion.
Broward County saw its business total rise by 2.7 percent to 45,179 in 1994, while payrolls rose by 6.2 perent, to $11.7 billion.
Palm Beach County's business total rose by 3.6 percent to 32,118 in 1994, while payrolls rose by 11.3 percent, to $9 billion.
Pinellas County's business total rose by 1.4 percent to 25,512 in 1994, while payrolls rose by 6.3 percent to $7.4 billion.
Hillsborough County's business total rose by 1.5 percent to 24,372 in 1994 while payrolls rose by 6.5 percent to $9.7 billion.
